issues.issue: Whether a Federal Court direction on the timing of a stay motion can be appealed to this Court
issues.applicant_position: Appellant says the Federal Court direction on the timing of his stay motion is appealable.
issues.respondent_position: Respondents move to terminate the appeal under Rule 74 and the statutory appeal bar in IRPA s.74(d).
issues.result_quote: I am not persuaded that the timing of the stay motion affects the appellant’s substantive arguments or rights for all time

issues.issue: Whether a 'jurisdiction' exception to the IRPA s.74(d) appeal bar applies, including the Federal Court's power to schedule the motion
issues.applicant_position: Appellant says the Federal Court exceeded its jurisdiction by removing his stay motion from general sittings.
issues.result_quote: Here, there is no issue of jurisdiction.

issues.issue: Whether a reasonable apprehension of bias, based on acting on respondents' letter, is an exception to the appeal bar
issues.applicant_position: Appellant says the judge acted on respondents' letter without waiting for his reply, creating reasonable apprehension of bias.
issues.result_quote: In any event, the appellant is making an allegation of procedural fairness, which is not an exception to the statutory bars

issues.issue: Whether a rule of law concern makes a judge-made exception to the appeal bar applicable
issues.applicant_position: Appellant says a rule of law concern makes the judge-made exceptions to the statutory bar apply.
issues.result_quote: In these circumstances, for the reasons set out in paragraph 8, this does not trigger any rule of law concerns.
